info.title: FastTemplate API
info.description: This is a sample FastAPI application with MongoDB integration.

post.description:
Exchange a Google authorization code for app authentication.

This endpoint:
1. Exchanges the authorization code for Google tokens (access, refresh, ID).
2. Verifies the Google ID token to extract user identity.
3. Creates or updates the user in the shared auth database.
4. Stores the encrypted refresh token for server-side Google API access.
5. Issues a signed JWT as an HttpOnly cookie for subsequent authenticated requests.

The JWT is set as a Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax cookie named 'auth-token'.
The frontend never handles the token directly.

get.description:
Get the currently authenticated user's information.

Used by the frontend on app load to validate the session cookie and
retrieve the user's profile. If the cookie is missing, invalid, or expired,
the auth middleware returns 401 before this handler runs.

post.description:
Issue a new JWT token for the authenticated user.

Call this endpoint when the current JWT is nearing expiry to get
a fresh token without requiring the user to re-authenticate with Google.
The new JWT is set as an HttpOnly cookie.

Log out the current user.

Revokes stored Google refresh tokens from the auth database
and clears the HttpOnly auth cookie.

post.summary: Remove the dominant background colour from an uploaded image
post.description: Upload a JPEG or PNG image (max 10 MB). The server finds the most-frequent pixel colour and makes every pixel within `tolerance` (Chebyshev per-channel distance) fully transparent, then returns the result as a base64-encoded PNG.

post.summary: Detect the dominant background colour of an uploaded image
post.description: Upload a JPEG or PNG image (max 10 MB). Returns the RGB values of the most-frequent pixel colour without modifying the image.

post.summary: Load an image from a server filesystem path
post.description: Read a JPEG or PNG image directly from the server filesystem. Returns the raw image bytes as base64 together with the dominant background colour.

post.summary: Remove background from an image using a server filesystem path
post.description: Read a JPEG or PNG image from the server filesystem and remove all pixels within *tolerance* of the specified RGB colour.  The path must be within an allowed access path.

post.summary: Save a PNG file to an allowed filesystem path
post.description: Persist a base64-encoded PNG file to the specified destination path. The destination must reside within one of the configured allowed access paths.

post.summary: Convert an uploaded JPG or PNG image to ICO format
post.description: Upload a JPEG or PNG image (max 10 MB). The server converts it to a multi-resolution ICO file and returns the result as base64-encoded data.

post.summary: Convert a JPG or PNG image to ICO format using a server filesystem path
post.description: Read a JPEG or PNG image from the server filesystem and convert it to a multi-resolution ICO file. The path must reside within one of the configured allowed access paths.

post.summary: Save a converted ICO file to an allowed filesystem path
post.description: Persist a base64-encoded ICO file to the specified destination path. The destination must reside within one of the configured allowed access paths.

post.description:
Registers a client to receive log messages via WebSocket.

This endpoint registers a client_id to receive real-time log broadcasts through
their active WebSocket connection. The client must have an active WebSocket
connection before registering for logs.

Args:
    x_client_id: Client ID from the request header
    
Returns:
    dict: Success status and registration details
    
Raises:
    HTTPException: If the client is not connected or already registered

parameters.name: x-client-id

schema.description: Client ID to register for log messages
schema.title: X-Client-Id

parameters.description: Client ID to register for log messages

post.description:
Deregisters a client from receiving log messages via WebSocket.

This endpoint removes a client_id from receiving real-time log broadcasts.
The client will no longer receive log messages but can still maintain their
WebSocket connection for other purposes.

Args:
    x_client_id: Client ID from the request header
    
Returns:
    dict: Success status and deregistration details
    
Raises:
    HTTPException: If the client is not registered

parameters.name: x-client-id

schema.description: Client ID to deregister from log messages
schema.title: X-Client-Id

parameters.description: Client ID to deregister from log messages

get.description:
Get the current API version.

Returns the current API version in semantic versioning format (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH).
The version is read from the api_version.txt file in the project root.

Returns:
    VersionResponse containing the current API version
Retrieve the list of paths that are allowed for accessing and storing attachments.
Retrieve all child folders and files within a given path. The path must be within the allowed access paths.

get.summary: Recursively list video files in a folder
get.description: Walks through the given folder and all subfolders, returning absolute paths of video files.

post.description: Create a new folder within an allowed path. The parent path must be within the allowed access paths.

get.description:
Serve the React Single Page Application (SPA).

This route acts as a catch-all:
1. It checks if the requested path exists as a physical file in the build directory 
   (e.g., assets/logo.png).
2. If the file exists, it serves that file.
3. If the file does not exist, it serves 'index.html', allowing React Router 
   to handle the client-side routing.

Args:
    full_path: The full URL path requested by the browser.

Returns:
    FileResponse: The requested static file or the index.html fallback.
